Fixture 001 at seed 3, run with adhd-branch and adhd-critic actually resolving under D41's WebSearch/WebFetch permit -- the first recorded run of this fixture where the critic's own instructions (blind pass A, mechanical eight-record trap sweep) were genuinely in force. All five branches fired T1 in pass B and the run pruned to zero survivors; deepen refused with 'every branch was pruned'. This is a legitimate run outcome, not a defect: the trap sweep found a real objection to all five positions. It used to fail must_surface human_cancel and retry_target_questioned, and must_not triple_only and must_not no_verdict, all four for one of two structural reasons the checks were not written to receive (backlog 105): the two must_not checks measured 'is this a bad answer' on a run that gave no answer at all, and 'all' scope could not see the retry-storm/cancellation language that only ever reached a pruned branch's reasoning field, because it fell back to nothing rather than to the full pruned set when every branch was pruned. Both were fixed in src/eval.ts (a named wipeout-sentinel guard on the two must_not checks, and an 'all' scope that falls back to every branch's full artifact, not just survivors, when there are none) and this run now passes cleanly: must_surface trap_named, retry_cost, human_cancel, retry_target_questioned, must_not triple_only, no_verdict, and every 'expect' assertion (pruned_min, pruned_traps_include_any) all pass.
